summary: Caller claims to be the IRS and says a refund is held pending a 'processing fee' of $290 that must be paid to a personal account before release. The IRS never requests payment of fees to release refunds.
recommended_actions: Do NOT pay any fee — the IRS does not collect refund 'processing fees'
Verify refund status on the official IRS site only
Report this number to your local consumer protection agency

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Good morning, this is an agent from the IRS benefits division. You have an outstanding tax refund of $4,200 pending release.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh great, when will it be sent?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We first need a $290 processing fee wired to our dedicated account. Once cleared, your check will be mailed within 48 hours.
